# Minicuration

Minicuration produces museum-quality reproductions of original paintings on 2.5×3.5-inch trading cards (ACEO format), in two collections. Limited editions are restricted to exactly 50 numbered prints per design and sealed in a rigid magnetic acrylic display case with a standing easel included. Unlimited cards are an open-edition run of archive paintings, not numbered. Every print reproduces a hand-painted original in acrylic, mixed media, and found materials (such as spray paint, ink, joint compound, latex, and epoxy resin) on canvas or wood panel. Minicuration is the trading-card label of the artist JFeelgood (https://jfeelgood.com): every card on the site is JFeelgood's work, and the site sells no other artist's. The back of each card carries the artist name, medium, edition number, and the artist's own statement about the work. Limited editions are on sale for $10 USD (regularly $23 USD); Sweet Dreams is $8 USD.

## Unlimited cards (open edition, $6 USD, regularly $15; 10 unlimited pieces for $50 USD with free shipping)

Open-edition cards of archive paintings by JFeelgood. Not numbered and not limited; the card back carries the painting's title, the artist's name and minicuration.com. Each ships in a protective plastic slip; a magnetically sealed acrylic case ($4 USD) and an acrylic display stand ($1 USD) are add-ons, one of each per card. Limited editions already include a case and a stand. Ships to US addresses only. US shipping is charged per order: $2 USD by untracked letter mail when the order is only unlimited cards, $7 USD as a tracked package when it includes a limited edition, case or stand, and free on orders of $50 USD or more. Every further 10 unlimited cards in the same order saves another $10.

## What makes Minicuration distinct

- Trading card size (2.5×3.5 inches) — sealed in a rigid magnetic acrylic case that stands on the included easel (the case is a protective display object, not a wallet insert)
- Limited editions: strictly 50 numbered prints per design; no reprints
- Each card ships sealed in a magnetic acrylic collector's case with a display stand
- Reproduces original paintings, not digital art — every print has a physical source work
- Artist statement on the back of every card
- Connects collectors directly to the artist via affordable, physical collectibles
- Sister site: https://jfeelgood.com
